verdict.rationale: Counsel on open-source license compliance is a fair question for a full-service law firm with IP and TMT practices, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item names OSS licensing, open-source compliance or OSS usage policies as a capability. The general IP practice (copyrights, SEP/FRAND licensing) and the TMT practice are adjacent areas and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, the firm counsels on open-source license compliance and OSS usage policies for product companies, documented as a named capability
